author: r1-L1
rationale: Grammar-state MoE: a trunk classifies each completed word from ctx and updates a 16-d recurrent parse state (slot, NP number, subject-role flag, main-verb-done, and-used, pending-verb stack encoded base-3 in one scalar, stack depth). A router maps the slot to one of 6 experts (det, adj/noun, post-noun, verb, adverb, punctuation/and). Each expert matches the current word prefix against its own lexicon, weights words by a hand-set prior chosen by parse situation, sums per next char, and takes a piecewise-linear log.
